verdict.rationale: cubic runs several review automations in the background once configured. It reviews every new PR automatically after install, can auto-approve PRs that meet a review policy, auto-resolves threads when issues are fixed, generates fixes in the background, and auto-analyzes PRs against linked Linear/Jira issues, with behavior set via cubic.yaml and custom agents. However, these are fixed, review-scoped behaviors: there is no evidence of user-defined automation workflows, schedules or custom triggers, and fixes generally still start from a 'Fix with cubic' click. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations (custom triggers/schedules beyond PR review), autonomous fix application without a manual request, independent hands-on corroboration of background operation.
